title: isolatedChild
responsibility: Spawns owned process groups with transparent or captured streams and truncates captured output at its byte limit.

inputs.name: isolatedChild.run
inputs.description: Owned command definition, environment, stream mode, log destination and process lifetime limits.

inputs.name: captureIsolatedOutput.child
inputs.description: Spawned owned process whose output stream is captured.

inputs.name: captureIsolatedOutput.output
inputs.description: Caller-owned byte chunks receiving captured output and a truncation marker when needed.

inputs.name: captureIsolatedOutput.limit
inputs.description: Maximum retained output bytes before the truncation marker.

outputs.name: isolatedChild
outputs.description: Detached owned child with inherited streams or captured stdout and merged stderr.

outputs.name: captureIsolatedOutput
outputs.description: Registers stream collection into the supplied chunks without exceeding the retained-byte limit.
